title: Fed and OCC Contact Banks About Unusual Activity After the Binance Hack
description: Federal Reserve and OCC officials contacted banks on Nov. 2 to ask about unusual activity or service disruptions following Binance's $6.34 billion security incident, Reuters reported.

title: Hong Kong Lawmakers Pass Crypto Tax Reporting Bill for 2027 Collection
description: Hong Kong's Legislative Council passed a bill on Nov. 4 putting the OECD Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework into local law, with service providers collecting user data from 2027 and exchanges starting in 2028.

title: CFTC gives futures exchanges 30 days to drop domestic geographic restrictions
description: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission said federally registered futures exchanges must stop restricting traders by their US location within 30 days or explain to the Division of Market Oversight why compliance is not feasible.

title: French Hill Wins Reelection but Is Set to Lose House Financial Services Chair
description: Republican French Hill won reelection in Arkansas' 2nd District and is expected to lose the House Financial Services Committee chairmanship when Democrats take control in January.

title: Ukraine Central Bank Opposes Crypto Bill Cleared for Second Reading
description: Ukraine's National Bank said on Nov. 4 it cannot support Draft Law No. 10225-d on virtual assets in its current form, objecting to foreign token access and operator licensing terms after a Rada committee cleared the bill for a final vote.
